output.summary: Group ticket time rose in every location in October 2024, exactly as the board's pre-approved study projected (13.5 to about 18 minutes). The board accepted that cost for the made-to-order positioning, and group-wide satisfaction rose. So there is no group-wide inefficiency, and the 12-minute benchmark and the frozen-component plan are not warranted. Riverside is a separate local problem. Its ticket time jumped after the saute/pasta cook left and the position went unfilled, and the KDS timings localize the delay to that station. Group operations deferred the GM's transfer requests. Staffing is not a group-wide problem. Delgado's reason for leaving is unclear: records show equal hour cuts for all four cooks, and the one account naming the GM is a single anonymous source. Replacing the GM is unjustified.
